experiment: E66 interchange_67m, the feasibility probe: can the context patch and the units share read anything on the 67M's fine-tunes? Controls only.
scope: These rules read only W0, the zero update and the three built controls. T, T_off, Q and U on E62's six states, the eight copy and random-map states and E62 Amendment 2's scaled copies are reported marked exploratory, with no filed verdict and no row label. A decision card after the run says whether the 41 rows get filed rules or E65 returns.

settings_sources.per_key: the plan's 64 contexts per key; unsourced beyond that (the plan's Departures)
settings_sources.copy_pairs: 16 per key x 32 keys, the count the quarter rule gives the other maps
settings_sources.u_every: chosen here for time: 256 windows, E62 read its shares on 200
settings_sources.amp_cap: chosen here: an upper limit on (1 + alpha) of 9, reported as status cap when reached; it bounds the control, it does not set a reading
settings_sources.match_tol: chosen here; E46's relative band is of this order (perturb.match)
settings_sources.sharpen: the plan: temperature 0.5 (unsourced), Adam 3e-5 and clip 1.0 from E12, 30 steps from the plan; batch and sampling are finetune.ReferenceConfig's default (E55 C3), KL over every position of plain Pile spans from training rows

threshold_sources.floor, z, min_pairs, min_keys, g_tol, ga: the plan (Rules against their edge cases; stages)
threshold_sources.transplant_tol: measured: E52's stage 0 identity edit read 1.7e-5 nats max per window at fp32 on its 48 windows, so the plan's 1e-6 would stop on rounding (E38 Amendment 3's lesson); about 6 times that. Noise floor measured again in this run as transplant_max.
threshold_sources.write_cond_max, write_rel_err_max: taken from E46's write readings, regating_table/results/amend3.json rows */write_G fit: cond_A 6.4-8.2, rel_err_mean 0.16-0.17. Twice the worst, since that write sat at block 1 on the key layout and this one sits at block 3, and on the lookup at the cue layout. Inside E46's filed write_ill_posed_rel_err of 0.5.
threshold_sources.q_band: chosen here, a lean. When 3 s_Q is over it Q reads void. A miss stops nothing
threshold_sources.write_t_min: chosen here, a lean; a miss stops nothing. Fable's finding 3: the last layer norm pulls T below 1 as the update grows
threshold_sources.blind_share: Fable's finding 1. A mark, not a filed verdict

C0_transplant.rule: In W0, x_hi's block-l input at every position, with the arm's stored x_hi site at the answer position, is written into x_lo's run. The largest |that read - x_hi's read| over all maps, both arms and blocks 1-3 is at most transplant_tol. A tie passes; nan fails.

C2_w0_response.rule: l* per map is the earliest of blocks 1, 2, 3 with mean R(W0) at least floor and at least z bootstrap sds of that mean (ties count); none, or fewer than min_pairs pairs or min_keys keys, voids the map. Stop if half the six maps or more are void.
C2_w0_response.expected: Copy map: R(W0) near 0 at blocks 1 and 2, l* = 3 (Fable's finding 1). Other maps: unknown, this is the probe's first question. Three void maps is a stop, as the plan's stage 0 has it.

C3_K.rule: K is the smallest of k_grid whose mean-ablation lowers W0's log-odds on the half-known map's held-out windows by at least k_fall (a tie counts).
C3_K.on_miss: U void everywhere; amplify is not built; stage 1 stops

C4_write.rule: At the map's l*: T in [write_t_min, 1 + z s] (ties count), and |Q - 1| within q_band (void when z s_Q is over q_band). write_conditioned: cond_A at most write_cond_max and mean relative error on single windows at most write_rel_err_max, ties pass. The copy map has no write: its reference is the lookup's write, read at the copy map's l*.
C4_write.expected: T near 1, below it when G is large (the last layer norm); Q near 1; conditioned
C4_write.on_miss: report; nothing stops, but an unconditioned write voids C5 on its map

C5_amplify.rule: At the map's l*, T(amplify) - T(write) > z max(s, s_write), strict. Void unless amplify's gain match has status ok and the map's write is conditioned (C4). Stop if this misses on half or more of the maps where it can be read, or none can be.
C5_amplify.also: the same on Q, under the same voiding, reported, not a stop: a miss means Q has no high control and T / T_off cannot see reuse even by algebra.
C5_amplify.expected: above on T; above on Q is a lean, since amplifying neurons may raise the off-map response too

C6_sharpen.rule: At the map's l*, T(sharpen) - 1 > z s, strict. Q: |Q - 1| within q_band, void unless that T holds and void when z s_Q is over q_band. Its gain over W0 on the map's U windows is recorded.
C6_sharpen.expected: T above 1 and at most about 2; Q near 1, since Q exists to cancel exactly this. If T does not clear 1, 30 steps did not sharpen at the marker: reported as too weak, and Q has no check against sharpening.

C7_units.rule: U(write) is not above the matched null's mean by more than z null sds; U(amplify) is. Strict.
C7_units.expected: write near the draws; amplify above, the more so the larger amplify_share_in_U_top, the share of amplify's neurons in U's top K, which is reported beside it and reads this rule: at l* over 0 amplify draws only from later blocks, so a low overlap explains a miss
C7_units.on_miss: report; a miss on either voids U's reading in the decision card

C8_reproduce.rule: Each of the fourteen states' gain re-reads within g_tol of its filed value: E62's in log-odds on its read windows (run.json), E46's in log P on its held-out windows (baseline_neurons.json gains).

expected_at.W0: T = 1 by definition; Q = 1; R(W0) is the denominator. U void (no gain).
expected_at.zero_update: In words only, not run: T = 1 holds by identity, since a zero update is W0, so it controls nothing. U would be void, G = 0 under gain_floor.
expected_at.do_nothing: Not built. T reads the target model, so a do-nothing state reads as its own state would (the plan's table).

noise_floor: s is the pair bootstrap sd of the ratio of means (n_boot resamples). Seed spread is read across each map's saved seeds in the report; the controls have one seed each, so their s is the pair sd only. Transplant: transplant_max, measured in the run.
size_reading_note: Exploratory and computed in the analysis from run.json, not by the run. Pairs are picked on W0's own metric, so R(W0) carries selection inflation and T can drift below 1 as the update grows, whatever the update's kind. A trend of T against the update's size can therefore come from the selection and the last layer norm; read it beside the same state's scaled copy (stage 4, T beside T_unscaled, Q beside Q_unscaled).

blind_to.T: An update upstream of l*: the patch overwrites it, so T reads the control's value (mark 'blind'). Attention at other positions. A new readout on W0's key features, since the key is fixed. A mechanism W0 has but does not run on this input. Pairs are picked on W0's own metric, so R(W0) carries selection inflation and T can sit below 1 for any state, drifting lower with update size.
blind_to.T_off and Q: A state that changes its off-map target's response on purpose. Q cancels only what the on-map and off-map responses share. The off-map odds leave out the map's target on both x_hi and x_lo (mask of two tokens per pair): on the copy map these differ, and x_hi's B entering x_lo's odds would otherwise move the off-map read.
blind_to.U: Gain carried by attention, and gain routed through neurons W0 does not rank highly for this answer.
blind_to.mark: Steering's mean shift misses window-specific changes, so 'readable' can overstate; its share on E46's states is in log P, on E62's in log-odds.

edge_cases.zero denominator, R(W0) under floor or z: ctxpatch.ratio gives nan at that block; l_star skips it; never a low reading.
edge_cases.negative mean R(W0): cannot pass the floor; void at that block, and printed in R0.
edge_cases.individual pairs with R(W0) at or below: kept: a ratio of means has no per-pair denominator.
edge_cases.under min_pairs pairs or min_keys keys: the map is void, l* None, no controls built; U is still read.
edge_cases.T_off void, not positive, or crossing 0: Q and s_Q are nan; C4 and C6 read void on Q, C5 reads void and stops nothing on Q.
edge_cases.T or a reference nan: above, near_one and t_band read 'void', counted neither as a pass nor as a miss.
edge_cases.every map void on amplify's T: stage1_status stops: no map can be read.
edge_cases.gain under gain_floor, including zero up: units_share is nan; U is void.
edge_cases.2 K over 12288: no room for a null of K neurons outside the top K: U is void on every state; amplify is still built.
edge_cases.z s_Q over q_band: near_one reads void: the reading cannot tell near from far.
edge_cases.amplify's gain match capped, or the map': C5 reads void on that map and stage 1's stop does not count it.
edge_cases.a nan in the transplant check: fails C0 whichever position it sits in: the maximum is taken with torch.max, which propagates it.
edge_cases.no K on the grid: U is void on every state, amplify is not built, and stage 1 stops since no map can be read.
edge_cases.a neuron cell empty in the null's grid: matched_draw falls back to the same activation decile, then any free neuron.
edge_cases.sharpening's T not above 1: C6's T reads not_above, its Q void.

granularity_limit: A new circuit from old pieces reads 'elicited' to VPD and can read reuse here too (user, 2026-10-29). No reading here labels a row.
